cases.title: Register a shop with a valid GSTIN: the first screen verifies the business before anything else
cases.preconditions: Signed in on test.gokesari.com as a new test user with no shop. A GSTIN that the staging KYC provider verifies (agreed with the owner; never a real person's number). Admin > Referral settings: code optional.
cases.steps:
1. Open https://test.gokesari.com/shop/register
2. Read the first screen “Verify your business”
3. Leave Referral code empty
4. Enter the GSTIN in “GST number (15 characters)”
5. Tick “I agree that GoKesari checks this number with the government record.”
6. Click “Verify GSTIN”
cases.expected: First screen “Verify your business” shows “Referral code (optional)”, “GST number (15 characters)”, the consent box and “Verify GSTIN” (disabled until the consent box is ticked); once a well-formed GSTIN is typed, a read-only “PAN (taken from your GST number)” shows characters 3-12 of it. After the check the wizard moves straight on — to “Owner name” only if the record names no owner, else to “Confirm your shop address”; the Verify tile shows ✓ and, opened again, the GSTIN with the badge “Verified” (also on the Payment step's GSTIN row). Fields filled from the record carry “✓ Verified from GST” (“✓ Verified from PAN” on the PAN route).

cases.title: GSTIN format is checked before any government check is made
cases.preconditions: Signed in on test.gokesari.com as a new test user with no shop.
cases.steps:
1. Open /shop/register and tick “I agree that GoKesari checks this number with the government record.” (Verify GSTIN is disabled until it is ticked; with a mandatory referral code also type a 3-character code)
2. Enter 27ABCDE1234F1Z (14 characters) and click Verify GSTIN
3. Enter 27ABCDE1234F1X5 (no Z at position 14) and click Verify GSTIN
4. Type the GSTIN in lower case
cases.expected: Each wrong value shows “Enter the 15-character GSTIN as on your GST certificate, for example 27ABCDE1234F1Z5.” and no check is counted. Lower case is accepted only if it is upper-cased automatically to a valid GSTIN.

cases.title: A shop without GST registers with PAN after the declaration and consent
cases.preconditions: Signed in on test.gokesari.com as a new test user with no shop. A PAN the staging KYC provider verifies. Known: the Sandbox test environment refused every PAN (defect D2) - mark Blocked if it still does.
cases.steps:
1. Open /shop/register
2. Click “I don't have GST, use PAN”
3. Enter the PAN
4. Try “Verify PAN” without ticking the boxes
5. Tick “My shop is not registered under GST.” and the consent box
6. Click “Verify PAN”
cases.expected: Without both ticks the PAN cannot be verified. With them, the PAN is verified and the wizard moves on. The link “I have a GST number” switches back to GSTIN.

cases.title: PAN format is checked
cases.preconditions: Signed in on test.gokesari.com as a new test user with no shop.
cases.steps:
1. Use the PAN route (“I don't have GST, use PAN”) and tick “My shop is not registered under GST.” and the consent box
2. Enter ABCDE1234 (9 characters) and click Verify PAN
3. Enter ABCD12345F and click Verify PAN
4. Enter 1BCDE1234F and click Verify PAN
cases.expected: Each shows “Enter the 10-character PAN, for example ABCDE1234F.” and no check is counted.

cases.title: A referral code in the link is applied automatically and cannot be changed
cases.preconditions: Signed in on test.gokesari.com as a new test user with no shop. A valid dealer / shop referral code. Rule shopReferrals on (Admin › Settings; off by default, on on test.gokesari.com) — with it off the code is applied but the field stays editable.
cases.steps:
1. Open /shop/register?ref=<valid code>
2. Look at the Referral code field
3. Try to edit it
cases.expected: The code is checked as soon as the page opens and the field says “✓ Applied. Only one code can be used, so it cannot be changed.”; the field is read-only and typing changes nothing (P2-D4, while rule shopReferrals is on; with it off only “✓ Applied” shows and the field stays editable).

cases.title: Unknown, expired and missing referral codes are explained, with a way to request one
cases.preconditions: Signed in on test.gokesari.com as a new test user with no shop. An expired code. Admin › Referral settings, shop registration: MANDATORY since migration 0100 (owner request 28-Oct-2026) unless an admin changed it — check under the current setting and switch it for the other wording (restore after).
cases.steps:
1. Enter NOSUCH99, a well-formed GSTIN, tick the consent box and click Verify GSTIN
2. Enter the expired code and click Verify GSTIN
3. With the code mandatory: leave it empty, then type 2 characters
4. Look for the “Request a referral code” link
cases.expected: NOSUCH99: “Referral code NOSUCH99 does not exist. Check the code, or request one.” (code mandatory) or “… Check the code, or leave it empty.” (code optional), with “Referral code NOSUCH99 does not exist.” under the field; the GSTIN is not checked. Expired: “Referral code <code> expired on <YYYY-MM-DD>. Check the code, …”. Mandatory: the field is labelled “Referral code” (no “(optional)”) and Verify GSTIN stays disabled while the code is empty or under 3 characters, so the screen never sends an empty code (the server refuses one with “Enter your referral code, or request one.”). The “Request a referral code” link (after “Don't have a referral code?”) shows while the field is empty or in error.

cases.title: Referral code and employee fields respect their limits
cases.preconditions: Signed in on test.gokesari.com as a new test user with no shop. Dealer programme on and off (check both).
cases.steps:
1. Type a 33-character code in Referral code
2. Type a code in lower case
3. With the dealer programme on, look for “Employee ID or name” and type 121 characters
4. Switch the dealer programme off and reload
cases.expected: Referral code stops at 32 characters and is upper-cased. “Employee ID or name” appears only when the dealer programme is on and stops at 120 characters.

cases.title: The number can be read from a photo of the GST certificate or PAN card
cases.preconditions: Signed in on test.gokesari.com as a new test user with no shop. A clear test photo of a GST certificate and a blurred one (test documents only).
cases.steps:
1. Click “📷 Read it from a photo of your GST certificate” (on the PAN route: “📷 Read it from a photo of your PAN card”)
2. Click “Take a photo or choose files” and choose the clear photo
3. Check the number found and click “These numbers are right — check them online”
4. Repeat with the blurred photo
cases.expected: The photo is read on the device: the clear photo's row shows “Number found — please check” and, after “These numbers are right — check them online”, the number fills the GST number / PAN field — nothing is checked until “Verify GSTIN” / “Verify PAN”. The blurred photo's row shows “Couldn't read — type it” (and “Choose which document this is.” when the document was not recognised); the GST number / PAN field stays unchanged.

cases.title: Paid government checks are capped per hour

cases.title: Government service down: the owner is told to try again and is not failed
cases.preconditions: Signed in on test.gokesari.com as a new test user with no shop. A way to make the KYC provider unreachable on staging (ask the developer); otherwise Blocked.
cases.steps:
1. With the provider unreachable, verify a GSTIN

cases.title: GSTIN linked to a different PAN is explained

cases.steps: 1. Verify that GSTIN

cases.title: Not-found, cancelled, suspended and inactive GSTINs are refused with their own messages
cases.preconditions: Signed in on test.gokesari.com as a new test user with no shop. Provider test numbers for each status.
cases.steps:
1. Verify a well-formed GSTIN that does not exist
2. Verify a cancelled, a suspended and an inactive GSTIN
cases.expected: Not found: “This number was not found in the government record. Please check it and try again.” Cancelled: “The government record shows this GSTIN as cancelled.” Suspended: “The government record shows this GSTIN as suspended.” Inactive: “The government record shows this number as inactive.” Each with the badge “Not verified”; the owner cannot continue with that number.

cases.title: GSTIN verified but its PAN not confirmed: the owner can carry on and the team checks it
cases.preconditions: Signed in on test.gokesari.com as a new test user with no shop. Provider test data where the GSTIN verifies but the derived PAN does not.
cases.steps:
1. Verify the GSTIN
2. Continue the wizard to the Payment step and click “Create my shop and pay”
3. As admin, open Seller verification review (/admin/seller-verification)
cases.expected: The wizard moves on and the next step shows a warning with the PAN's reason: “The name on the PAN does not match the name on the GST record. We'll check it by hand.” (name mismatch), “The government record gave no name. We'll check it by hand.”, “The government service is not answering right now. You can carry on — we'll keep checking.” (PAN service down) or “We couldn't confirm this automatically. You can carry on — our team will check it.” (any other review). The Payment step still says “Your GSTIN is verified: your shop goes live as soon as the payment is confirmed.” Once the shop is created, a PAN under review is listed in Seller verification review with Approve / Ask for more info / Reject (a PAN still waiting for the service is retried automatically and is not listed). A PAN the government refuses (inactive, expired) stops the owner on the identity step instead.

cases.title: Udyam, FSSAI and Shop Act numbers go to manual review, not failure
cases.preconditions: Signed in as a shop owner with a registered shop.
cases.steps:
1. On Shop verification (/shop/verification) enter a Udyam, an FSSAI and a Shop Act number (the Shop Act card also asks for the certificate or Form G receipt), tick the consent and click Verify on each
2. As admin, open Seller verification review (/admin/seller-verification)
cases.expected: Each card on Shop verification shows “Under review” with “This document can't be checked online. Our team will review it.” (Sandbox.co.in checks only PAN and GSTIN), never “Not verified”; Seller verification review lists each with Approve, Ask for more info and Reject (a reason of at least 3 characters to reject or ask); an approved one becomes Verified, a rejected one Not verified.

cases.title: Owner step appears only when the record names no owner
cases.preconditions: Signed in on test.gokesari.com as a new test user with no shop. A test GSTIN whose record has no owner name, and one that has.
cases.steps:
1. Verify the GSTIN with no owner name
2. Enter “A” as owner name and continue
3. Enter a full name
4. Repeat with the GSTIN that names an owner
cases.expected: Without an owner the “Owner name” step says “Your GST record is for <legal name> (<constitution>) and names no owner. Who owns or runs the shop?” (“Your record names no owner. Who owns or runs the shop?” when the record gives no business name); with “A” Continue stays disabled (the server refuses a one-letter name with “Enter the owner's name.”); a full name continues to “Confirm your shop address”. With an owner on record (a proprietor's PAN) the step is skipped.

cases.title: Address step shows the verified address; Address, City and PIN code are required, the rest optional
cases.preconditions: Signed in on test.gokesari.com as a new test user with no shop. A GSTIN that the staging KYC provider verifies (agreed with the owner; never a real person's number).

1. Reach “Confirm your shop address”

3. Fill the required fields, leave State and (under “More”) Address line 2, Area and Landmark empty, click “Confirm address”

cases.title: Registration fee follows the turnover slab, plus GST

cases.title: Contact number and shop name limits are enforced

cases.steps:

A 1-character shop name is refused (server: “Shop name is required.”); the field stops at 120 characters, so a 121st is not taken.

cases.title: Review step shows everything entered and what happens on payment

3. Read the button
cases.expected: The step titled “Payment” lists GSTIN (masked, “Verified”), Referral code, Owner, Shop address, Map pin (“Placed”), Shop (name · shop email) and Turnover (with the fee), each with “Change”; the values are kept after Change and continuing again. With a verified GSTIN: “Your GSTIN is verified: your shop goes live as soon as the payment is confirmed.” Button: “Create my shop and pay”.

cases.title: Old registration links lead to the one flow and keep the referral code

cases.title: Paying the fee takes a verified shop live and e-mails the owner

Pay with Cashfree sandbox test data (UPI testsuccess@gocash) or, when PAYMENT_GATEWAY=SANDBOX, the built-in page “Pay (success)”. A valid referral code (the shop referral code is mandatory: referral_required_shop = MANDATORY since migration 0100; “Verify GSTIN” stays off without one).
cases.steps:

2. Pay the fee
3. Read the next screen
4. Check the owner's mailbox
5. As a customer at the shop's PIN, look for the shop
cases.expected: Screen: “Your onboarding is complete and your shop is live for accepting orders.” E-mail “Your onboarding is complete — <shop> is now live”. Shop status Live in Seller Central. The shop is listed for its PIN (products appear once added).

cases.title: A failed fee payment takes no money and can be retried

cases.expected: After the failure: “Your last payment did not go through / No money was taken for it. You can try again below.” (P2-D2). The retry succeeds and the shop goes live; only one successful payment is recorded.

cases.title: An unpaid wizard shop is told it goes live on payment
cases.preconditions: Signed in on test.gokesari.com as a new test user with no shop. A wizard shop created but not paid.
cases.steps:

2. Open Manage > Registration and fee
3. Look at the header badge
4. Browse the storefront and add an item to the cart
cases.expected: Home / Today's work: “Pay the registration fee of ₹X online. Your shop goes live as soon as the payment is confirmed.” Steps read “Shop registered / Registration fee paid / Shop live” (not “Approved by GoKesari”). “payment pending” badge on the panel and “Payment pending” in the header (P2-D1). The owner can still shop as a customer.

cases.title: Done screen offers bank account, delivery set-up, my shop and another shop

cases.expected: “Registration successful 🎉” with tiles “Get paid” (/shop/bank-account) and “How you deliver” (/shop/setup/delivery), buttons “Go to my shop” and “Register another shop” (/shop/register?new=1); each opens the right page.

cases.title: Live screen asks how to add products and links the template

cases.steps:

3. Click “Download product template”

cases.expected: Text: “Add your products so customers can select them and place orders with you. How would you like to add them?” with “Add products manually” and “Upload using template”. Download gives GoKesari_Product_Upload_Template.xlsx; upload opens /shop/product-import.

cases.title: Registration date is the IST date (P2-D6)

cases.steps:

2. Read the registration date in Seller Central (Manage → Registration and fee) and, as admin, in the shop record (GET /api/shops/<id> → registrationDate; no admin screen shows the registration date)
cases.expected: Both show today's IST date (e.g. a shop created 02.14 IST on 15-Nov shows 15/11/2026 in Seller Central and 2026-11-15 in the record; a day below 10 has no leading zero, e.g. 5/11/2026), not the UTC date.

cases.title: Same GSTIN or PAN already registered by another account: the shop is held, not live
cases.preconditions: Signed in on test.gokesari.com as a new test user with no shop. The GSTIN of an existing staging shop owned by another test account.
cases.steps:
1. On “Verify your business” enter that GSTIN (or, with “I don't have GST, use PAN”, its PAN), tick the consent and press “Verify GSTIN”
2. Race variant: verify a GSTIN no shop has yet, let another test account register and pay a shop with it, then finish your registration (another name / PIN) and pay the fee
3. As admin, open Shops → Instant approvals (Waiting)
cases.expected: Step 1 is refused before any government check: the alert “A shop with this GSTIN is already registered on GoKesari by another account. <state> If it is yours, sign in with the account that registered it, or contact support.”, where <state> is “It is live on GoKesari.” / “It is waiting for its registration fee or admin approval.” / “It is registered but not active at the moment.”, and the GSTIN field “This GSTIN is already registered.” (PAN route: “A shop with this PAN is already registered on GoKesari by another account. …”, field “This PAN is already registered.”). The owner cannot go on, so no shop is created and nothing is paid. Race variant: after payment “Payment received — pending admin approval” — “<shop> is pending admin approval. We'll email you as soon as your shop is live.”; the shop stays PENDING_APPROVAL and Instant approvals lists it “waiting for admin” — “Why waiting: likely duplicate of another shop (gstin, pan)”.

cases.title: The same owner cannot register the same shop name twice at one PIN
cases.preconditions: Signed in as an owner who already has shop 'X' at PIN 411005, live (a shop still waiting for its fee blocks any new registration — TC-ONB-078). The new registration uses another GSTIN / PAN.
cases.steps: 1. Register a new shop named 'X' at 411005
cases.expected: On “Continue to payment” (Contact and shop details) the alert says “You have already registered a shop with this name at this PIN code. This shop is already registered and live on GoKesari. If you're the owner and need to update details, log in to your account or contact support.” (the second sentence follows shop 'X''s status) and the Shop name field “You have already registered a shop with this name at this PIN code” (P2-D3). With the same GSTIN / PAN as 'X' the PAN rule matches first: “PAN number already registered (XXXXXX…). This shop is already registered and live on GoKesari. …”.

cases.title: A second shop cannot be started while the first is unpaid
cases.preconditions: Signed in as an owner with one unpaid wizard shop.
cases.steps: 1. Open /shop/register?new=1
cases.expected: “<shop> still has its registration fee to pay. Please pay it first — you can add another shop after that.” with “Pay the registration fee”, which opens that shop's payment.

cases.title: A similar name nearby or a shared mobile does not hold a verified, paid shop
cases.preconditions: Signed in on test.gokesari.com as a new test user with no shop. A GSTIN that the staging KYC provider verifies (agreed with the owner; never a real person's number). An existing shop with a similar name in the same PIN.
cases.steps:
1. Register with a similar name and the same mobile as another shop
2. Pay the fee
cases.expected: The shop goes live immediately (DI-13); it is not put on hold.

cases.title: Shop type decides the mandatory licence and the 90-day grace notice
cases.preconditions: Signed in on test.gokesari.com as a new test user with no shop, on “Contact and shop details” (after Verify, the address and the map pin).
cases.steps:
1. Pick a food shop type (e.g. Bakery, Grocery / Kirana Store)
2. Pick Pharmacy / Medical Store
3. Pick Doctor's Clinic (and Super Speciality Clinic)
4. Pick Professional office — CA, CS, advocate, tax consultant
5. Pick General Trading Store
cases.expected: Food: “FSSAI licence is mandatory for this type of shop. Your shop can go live now, and you have a grace period of 90 days to upload it. Otherwise, your shop will be suspended.” Pharmacy: the same with “Drug licence”. Clinics: “Medical registration”. Professional office: “Professional registration (Bar Council, ICAI or ICSI)”. General Trading Store: no notice. (90 = rule shopDocumentFollowUp.graceDays.) Go-live is never blocked.

cases.title: Grace notice e-mail gives the due date
cases.preconditions: A food shop made live without an FSSAI licence.
cases.steps: 1. Check the owner's mailbox after go-live
cases.expected: E-mail (and in-app notice) “Upload your licence within 90 days — <shop>”: “<the shop-type notice of TC-ONB-080> Please upload it on GoKesari by <date>. We will remind you every 15 days until then.”, <date> = the go-live (approval) date in IST + 90 days, e.g. “18 Feb 2027”.

cases.title: Reminders every 15 days until the licence is uploaded
cases.preconditions: A wizard shop in grace (live, licence not uploaded). The follow-up is part of the 05.00 IST daily cron and acts only on the rule's reminder days (shopDocumentFollowUp.reminderDaysOfMonth: the 1st and the 15th); a hand-triggered POST /api/cron/daily on another day does nothing for it.
cases.steps:
1. Let a run happen (or trigger it on a reminder day)
2. Read the reminder
3. Upload the licence and the Shop Act certificate
4. Trigger the next run
cases.expected: Reminder (e-mail and in-app) “Submit your shop documents — reminder <n>”: “<shop> is live, but these documents are still missing: <list>. Your shop went live before its documents; they are due by <date>. Upload them on GoKesari so we can verify them. If they are still missing on <date>, your shop will be suspended automatically. We will remind you every 15 days until then.” — <list> names every missing document, the Shop Act certificate as well as the licence (e.g. “FSSAI licence / registration, Shop Act (Shops & Establishments) certificate”). No reminder once every listed document is uploaded (a document waiting for GoKesari's check is not chased); with only the licence uploaded the Shop Act is still chased.

cases.title: After the grace period the shop is suspended automatically and customers are told
cases.preconditions: A food shop whose grace has ended (set graceDays to 15 and back-date the approval on staging only, with the developer), and the follow-up run on a reminder day (1st / 15th, or reminderDaysOfMonth set to today). Restore after.
cases.steps:
1. Trigger the follow-up run
2. Open the shop in Seller Central
3. Check admin / operator notifications
4. As a customer open the shop page
cases.expected: The shop is SUSPENDED by the run. Seller Central: “Your shop is suspended” — “Reason: Shop documents not submitted within <graceDays> days of approval without them: <list>.” and “What to do: Upload <list> on GoKesari (Shop → Verification). Our team reinstates the shop once they are verified.” Admins and operators get “Shop suspended for missing documents: <shop>” — “<shop> was suspended automatically because these documents were not uploaded in time: <list>.” Public page: “This shop is suspended and is not taking orders.”

cases.title: Grace days setting accepts 15 to 365 only
cases.preconditions: Signed in as admin on staging.
cases.steps:
1. Admin → Business rules → shopDocumentFollowUp: set graceDays to 14, then 366, then 15 and 365 in the JSON and press Save each time
2. Restore 90 (“Restore default”)
cases.expected: 14 and 366 are refused (“graceDays: …” under the editor; the API answers 422 “That value is not allowed for this setting.”); 15 and 365 are saved (“Saved.”).

cases.title: Unfinished registration: reminders after 24 h and again 48 h later
cases.preconditions: Signed in on test.gokesari.com as a new test user with no shop. Stop at the Address step. Time can be shortened only with the developer on staging.
cases.steps:
1. Wait 24 h (or shorten)
2. Read the e-mail
3. Wait 48 h more
cases.expected: First reminder (e-mail and in-app) 24 h after the last step: “Your shop is <N> steps from going live” — “You stopped at "<step>". Everything you entered is saved — continue where you left off: <site>/shop/register” (stopped at the Address step: “Your shop is 4 steps from going live”, “Confirm your shop address”). A second reminder 48 h later (72 h idle), then none.

cases.title: The dealer whose code was used is told after 72 h
cases.preconditions: A registration started with a dealer's code and left idle 72 h.
cases.steps: 1. Check the dealer's notifications / e-mail
cases.expected: With the second (72 h) reminder the dealer gets an in-app notice (not e-mailed by default) “A shop with your code has not finished registering” — “<owner> started registering a shop with your code <CODE> 3 days ago and stopped at "<step>". A call may help them finish.” Only for a code of an outside (not internal) dealer.

cases.title: Paying or finishing cancels the pending reminders

cases.expected: No reminder e-mail is sent after payment.

cases.title: A draft idle for 7 days is abandoned and the owner starts again

cases.steps: 1. Open /shop/register
cases.expected: The draft is ABANDONED; the owner restarts on the first screen after sign-in, “Verify your business” (tile 2. Verify, “Step 2 of 5”), with the referral code and GST / PAN to enter again.

cases.title: Guided 3-step product set-up

Step 2 offers “Select products on screen” (Recommended on phone) and “Add in bulk with Excel”. Products with stock and price become Live.

cases.title: Listing statuses and filters in My products

cases.title: Customers see only Live listings

3. Open Compare prices

cases.title: Stock and price editor refuses impossible prices

Apply shows “Enter a discount from 1 to 99 percent.” for 0% and for 100% and changes no price. After Save, the row shows “A price can be at most ₹10,00,000.” and the page “1 product was not saved. Look for the messages in red.” Nothing is saved for refused values.

cases.title: Phone layout and shop switcher in product set-up (D-2, D-3)

cases.title: Product import template downloads with drop-downs and imports valid rows

cases.title: Update many products with Excel

cases.title: Every rejected setup row says why (D-1 'Add new product')
